about: Sample boxes (fractions of the frame) for calibration_colours.py: the same surface in a look-loop frame and in a style-b-calibration-v2 frame. The calibration frames are painted stills with their OWN camera and content, so each frame has its own boxes; the engine boxes come from regions.json. Absolute dE is therefore a surface-class distance, not a same-camera one: judge the direction of a move between runs. 'mask' keeps only pixels of that class inside the box (brick = sunlit terracotta). The pack owns lighting, exposure, saturation and matte materials; wall albedo stays with the packs (R, 2026-10-07), so wall is shown for reference only.

notes.wilmette-street-afternoon: The pack has no Wilmette frame; the Chicago frame is the nearest regional look. Its walls are profile colours, not calibration content.
notes.ordinary-street-afternoon: 06-sloans is a lakeside path (autumn engine frame, green-season calibration): only sky and the concrete path are comparable.
